article.p1: For anyone searching for the right place to learn English in Avcılar, the same question always comes up: which course actually gets results? At Avcılar English Course, our speaking-focused curriculum pushes students toward real practice instead of rote memorization. In classes suited to every level from A1 to C1, both children and adults progress at their own pace toward measurable, concrete language growth.
article.h2: What Learning English in Avcılar Really Adds to Your Life
article.p2: Most people researching an English course in Avcılar are after more than just a new language: a new career path, a strong exam score, or simply the confidence to express themselves in everyday life. Whatever your goal, steady progress is possible with the right study plan and consistent practice. Let's look at exactly what learning English can bring you:
article.promoImgAlt: 1 Gram Gold Gift - Start the New Year Like Gold!
article.readMore: Click to Continue Reading About Avcılar English Course

expandedContent.text: Used in some form by more than two billion people worldwide, English is no longer just a 'nice to have' skill — in many industries, it's become a hiring requirement. If you want to work at an international company, correspond with an overseas office, or reach clients globally as a freelancer, fluent English puts you a step ahead of the competition. Being able to speak English in an interview can be one of the most memorable lines on your résumé.
How Does Training Work at Avcılar English Language Course?

Every student who enrolls at Avcılar English Language Course starts with a free placement test, so instead of repeating what they already know, they begin exactly where they need to. Our classes develop all four core skills — listening, speaking, reading, and writing — at the same time, and regular speaking club sessions turn what's learned into real conversation. Practice sessions with native-speaking instructors noticeably improve your pronunciation and fluency in a short time.
What It Adds to Your Academic and Personal Growth

Knowing English opens doors far beyond the workplace — it matters academically too. If you're planning a master's or PhD abroad, most universities require require proof of English proficiency as part of the application. And since the majority of current scientific papers are published in English, your language skills let you follow developments in your field firsthand.
The Role of English in Travel and Daily Life

Beyond education and career, English is a practical tool that makes travel easier — from finding your way at the airport and checking into a hotel, to chatting with locals and getting a closer look at different cultures. The phrases you learn at Avcılar English Course come from real-life scenarios rather than textbook dialogues, so you won't feel unprepared once you're abroad.
What Determines Avcılar English Course Prices?

Prices for English courses in Avcılar generally range between ₺9,500 and ₺38,000, depending on the scope and length of the program you choose. This range isn't arbitrary — each price bracket corresponds to a different need.

One of the biggest factors in pricing is course duration: intensive short programs tend to be more affordable, while comprehensive, long-term programs require a bigger budget. Instructor experience matters too — lessons taught by native speakers or internationally certified instructors are usually priced higher than standard programs. Course materials, class size, and the technology used also shape the total cost. If you want quality education without straining your budget, group classes or online options are worth considering — but keep in mind that the cheapest option isn't always the most effective one.
What to Look for When Choosing the Right Course in Avcılar

Before committing to a language course in Avcılar or Kadıköy, there are a few things worth checking. Whether the institution is officially recognized, the qualifications of its instructors, and honest feedback from past students are among the most fundamental criteria that will shape your decision.

Just as important is whether the program actually matches your goal. Are you preparing for an exam like IELTS or TOEFL, or trying to improve your everyday conversation skills? Or are you aiming for an academic exam like YKS-DİL (YDT)? The clearer your goal, the easier it becomes to find the program that fits.

At Avcılar English Language Course, we know every student arrives with a different goal — that's why we tailor our programs individually and speed up the learning process with interactive, speaking-focused methods. Learning a language is a marathon, not a sprint, and with the right guidance, that journey can become an enjoyable, results-driven experience. Get in touch with us today for a free placement test and to discover the program that's right for you.

faq.title: Most Frequently Asked Questions About Avcılar English Course
faq.desc: If you are looking for an English course in Avcılar and have questions in your mind, you are in the right place. We have answered the most curious questions about the Avcılar English Language Course and their detailed answers for you.

items.q: Does the Best English Course in Avcılar offer weekend programs?
items.a: As the Most Recommended English Language Course in Avcılar, we continue our English education on weekends, taking into account the busy weekday schedules of our students in Avcılar. Our programs held on Saturdays and Sundays enable both working professionals and students with busy school terms to achieve their English learning goals. These flexible programs are shaped according to our students' preferences with morning or afternoon classes. Our weekend courses are designed with an intensive and effective curriculum, aiming for students to make significant progress in a short time.

items.q: Is a placement test conducted before the course?
items.a: As the English Language Course at the top of the list in Avcılar's Best Foreign Language Course rankings, we conduct a pre-course placement test at our Avcılar branch. This test is designed to determine our students' current English levels and place them in the most appropriate classes. Our exam provides a comprehensive evaluation measuring reading, writing, listening, and speaking skills. Thus, we can create the most effective education program according to the needs and current language level of each student. Our placement test is free of charge and can be taken by appointment before course registration.

items.q: Are there trial lessons at your Avcılar English Course branch?
items.a: Free trial lessons are available at our Avcılar English Course branch, and you can participate by making an appointment for all levels. In our trial lesson, you can experience the real classroom environment, meet our teachers, and get a closer look at our course methodology.

about.title: Build a Solid Foundation with PREP Basic English Course
about.desc:
Avcılar Basic English Course (PREP) is an A1 (Beginner) starter course perfectly aligned with Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR) standards, specially designed for those starting English from scratch or lacking a sufficient foundation.

Our students are placed in the most suitable classes based on the results of a free placement test. Our PREP education model is not just a rote-learning system; it offers an integrated approach where Grammar, Speaking, Listening, and Reading-Writing skills are developed simultaneously.

Supported by adult-specific up-to-date content and our own original materials, this program ensures you can express yourself comfortably in daily life and permanently acquire basic English communication skills.

skills.title: Grammar
skills.desc: Basic English sentence structure and differences with Turkish are analyzed. A1 level vocabulary, beginner tenses, and grammar rules are covered in detail to build a solid grammatical foundation.

skills.title: Reading
skills.desc: Accompanied by carefully selected basic level reading passages; reading comprehension speed is increased through English vocabulary building, phrasal verbs, and word formation exercises.

skills.title: Writing
skills.desc: With English writing exercises where learned grammar and vocabulary rules are put into practice, your basic email writing, reading comprehension, and sentence construction skills are developed to academic standards.

skills.title: Speaking & Listening
skills.desc: Through interactive Speaking and Listening practices suited to your level, you gain self-confidence in speaking English and lay the foundations for fluent communication in daily life.

about.title: Express Yourself with More Complex Structures: Prep Plus
about.desc:
At this level, our students express themselves better in speaking and writing skills by constructing complex sentence structures along with more detailed and higher-level grammar education.

Based on the placement test given to students transitioning from the Prep level to the Prep Plus English Course or newly registered students, we place those who have sufficient knowledge in basic Grammar but lack in more complex Tense and Grammar structures, and who can make sense of basic reading passages but cannot grasp the integrity of meaning in more complex passages, into the Prep Plus classes, which are one level above the Prep level.

Students in our Prep Plus classes take a Grammar lesson where more complex Tenses and high-level sentence structures that have no equivalent in Turkish are taught, rather than simple tenses. They also take Listening and Reading lessons where passages slightly higher than the Prep class level are examined with reading comprehension, listening, and writing exercises, and a Speaking lesson spoken appropriately for their level.

about.title: Understand the Language Deeply with Grammar and Translation: Academic Express
about.desc:
In the Academic Express English Course, our students learn to contextualize the grammar and vocabulary they learned in the Prep and Prep Plus periods in reading, writing, speaking, and listening skills through TR-ENG, ENG-TR grammar translation lessons.

It is a term education that enables students to deeply understand how the language works by analyzing grammar rules and breaking sentences down into their components with the grammar translation method, aimed at using the grammar and vocabulary structures learned in the Prep and Prep Plus periods fluently in daily and business life by contextualizing them in sentences.

Our students in Academic Express classes take a Grammar-translation lesson that allows them to think differently in both languages and see the distinctive nuances in both languages by translating texts TR-ENG, ENG-TR, and Reading and Listening lessons where reading comprehension, listening, and writing exercises are done by performing text analyses in high-level Listening and Reading passages, increasing vocabulary competence usable in daily and business life, and Speaking lessons where learned grammar rules and vocabulary are put into practice.

about.desc:

Our institution offers a quality education that will take you to the next level in your academic career.

With years of experience and our senior teachers, we conduct comprehensive sentence analyses covering technical, legal, medical, commercial, and academic terminology in our academic classes with our institution-specific publications and our Translation 1 book.

Our Academic Reading 1 book also provides the detailed uses of phrasal verbs, phrases, idioms, and collocations, and Listening lessons are held with reading passages covering terminological and current topics.

In the Academic Semester, our students reach a state where they can express themselves at a high level with a comprehensive vocabulary based on word formation, idioms, collocations, and phrasal verbs.

Just as there are differences between the Turkish we speak daily and the Turkish used in business life and the academic community, the same is true for English. Avcılar English Language Course Educational Institutions, the first institution to provide academic English education in Turkey, is a language academy where you can learn high-level English.

Corporate English is a specific language skill used to communicate effectively and develop professional relationships in the business world. With the international growth of the business world, using English effectively has become increasingly important when communicating between companies and competing in global markets.

Corporate English training helps employees communicate more effectively with both foreign clients and international business partners. about.title: What is an Effective GRE Preparation Process?
about.desc:
GRE (Graduate Record Examination) is one of the most popular globally recognized exams required for students aiming for master's and doctoral degrees abroad. Required by many universities, especially in the United States, this exam was first administered in 1949 by Educational Testing Service (ETS).

Scope of the Exam: The Goethe Institute exams comply fully with the language levels of the Common European Framework of Reference for Languages (CEFR). In this system, candidates' German knowledge is evaluated from level A1 to C2.

info.title: What is E-TEP Exam?
info.desc: The E-tep exam aims to measure English language proficiency and is organized by Turkey's Student Selection and Placement Center (ÖSYM). It evaluates participants' reading, listening, writing, and speaking skills.

seoContent.title: What is the E-TEP Exam?
seoContent.desc:
The E-tep (Electronic Test of English Proficiency) exam aims to measure English language proficiency and is organized by ÖSYM. Following a long preparation period, a pilot application was held on July 22-23, 2023, at the Ankara Esenboğa Exam Center.

The exam evaluates candidates' reading, listening, writing, and speaking skills. These four skills combined are expected to reflect individuals' overall English proficiency.

seoContent.title: What is the Purpose of the E-TEP Exam?
seoContent.desc:
The purpose of the E-TEP exam is to objectively measure language skills by comprehensively evaluating candidates' abilities in reading, listening, writing, and speaking. Additionally, the exam aims to approach the standards of internationally recognized and highly respected exams like TOEFL, IELTS, and PTE.

The future goal of the E-TEP exam is to reach a respected position internationally and become a reliable reference point measuring English proficiency worldwide.

seoContent.title: Part One: Reading and Listening Skills
seoContent.summary: This section measures your reading and listening skills, testing your capacity to understand English.

seoContent.title: Reading Section
seoContent.desc: The Reading section in the E-TEP Exam has similar characteristics to IELTS, TOEFL, and PTE exams. In this section:
bullets: There are a total of 16 questions.
60 minutes are given for the questions.
Question types include multiple-choice, paragraph ordering, and paragraph questions.
Texts have academic content and a different format from YDS and YÖKDİL.
Important parts can be highlighted and notes can be taken during reading.
It shows the most similarity to the TOEFL reading section.

seoContent.title: Listening Section
seoContent.desc: The Listening section in the E-TEP Exam includes listening formats of international exams in a mixed format:
bullets: There are a total of 27 questions.
36 minutes are given for the questions.
The first two audio files have a slower tempo compared to other academic exams.
It mostly consists of short, three-option questions.
It shows similarity to the early multiple-choice sections of IELTS.
Audio files and videos are voiced by Turkish speakers.
There are also integrated skill questions with video content.

seoContent.title: Part Two: Writing and Speaking Skills
seoContent.desc: This section tests language production and expression skills. It highlights candidates' abilities to express their thoughts creatively and logically in written and spoken forms.

seoContent.title: Writing Section
seoContent.desc: The E-TEP Exam Writing section includes writing formats of international exams in a mixed format:
bullets: There are a total of 2 tasks.
50 minutes are given for the entire section.

Task 1: It is in the format of blog/email writing, requiring an informal text about a specific situation or topic. This task is similar to the letter/email format in the IELTS General Training writing section.

Task 2: It requires you to write a report by analyzing information from a visual material (graph, table, etc.) and a listened podcast content. This task measures your ability to synthesize information from multiple sources, similar to the integrated writing section of the TOEFL exam.
Word limits vary between 130-300 words depending on the task type.

seoContent.title: Speaking Section
seoContent.desc: The E-TEP Exam Speaking section is prepared in a mixed format inspired by the speaking sections of international exams:
bullets: There are a total of 4 tasks.
11 minutes are given for the entire section.
The first task is a "warm-up" and is not evaluated. (introducing yourself)
It has similar characteristics to PTE and TOEFL Speaking structures.
There are opinion questions regarding video content taken from TRT World.
Since all candidates speak at the same time during the exam, there can be sound interference.

seoContent.title: Who Can Take the E-TEP Exam?
seoContent.desc:
Candidates applying for the E-TEP exam are expected to have at least B2 level General English skills or have scored 70 and above in national and international English exams like YDS, E-YDS. Candidates should prepare for the specific skills required by the exam and study for the different sections of the exam.

To get more information about the E-TEP Exam and detailed explanations, you can consult our experts at our Istanbul, Bursa, Izmir, and Ankara branches and find answers to all your questions about the exam.

seoContent.title: How Long is the E-TEP Exam Duration?
seoContent.desc:
The duration of the E-TEP exam has been set to 160 minutes. However, the exam is currently in the pilot application phase, and it is thought that the duration might be shortened in the future.

The E-TEP exam consists of two main sections:

seoContent.title: E-TEP Exam Part One Duration: Reading and Listening
bullets: There are a total of 16 questions in the Reading section, and candidates are given 60 minutes to answer these questions.
There are a total of 27 questions in the Listening section, and candidates are given 36 minutes to answer these questions.
There is a 5-minute break after the first section is completed.

seoContent.title: E-TEP Exam Part Two Duration: Speaking and Writing
bullets: The Speaking section includes 4 different tasks, and candidates are given a total of 11 minutes for this section.
The Writing section includes 2 different tasks, and candidates are given a total of 50 minutes for this writing section.

seoContent.title: E-TEP's Comparison with International Exams
seoContent.desc: According to expert evaluation, the E-TEP exam is a hybrid version of internationally recognized exams:
bullets: Reading: Contains a format closer to TOEFL Reading, with similar academic texts and question types.
Listening: Similar structure to IELTS Listening's multiple-choice questions, but also includes video content.
Speaking: Designed as a mix of the introductory section (warm-up) in the PTE exam and TOEFL integrated speaking sections.
Writing: Includes email/blog writing in the IELTS General Training Task 1 format and essay writing based on multimedia content like in the TOEFL integrated writing section.

prosConsTable.title: Pros and Areas for Improvement of the E-TEP Exam

rows.pro: A national exam comprehensively measuring all four skills (reading, listening, writing, speaking)
rows.con: Sound interference occurs in the Speaking section because all candidates speak simultaneously

rows.pro: Offers more generous time limits compared to international exams
rows.con: Instructions can be complex in some sections

rows.pro: Allows note-taking, marking, and underlining in the reading section
rows.con: Limited number of sample questions as it is a new exam

rows.pro: Increased security level thanks to a double login process
rows.con: International equivalency processes have not yet been completed

rows.pro: Its hybrid structure includes multiple exam formats together
rows.con: The validity period and acceptability of exam results are not yet clear

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions about the E-TEP Exam
faq.desc: You can find answers to all frequently asked questions about the E-TEP exam on this page.

items.q: Does the E-TEP exam have international validity?
items.a: The E-TEP exam does not currently have full international validity, but ÖSYM is actively working towards this. Developed as Turkey's first four-skill English proficiency test, E-TEP is designed to align with global standards using a hybrid format of internationally recognized exams. Since the exam is still in the pilot and development phase, equivalency and recognition processes are ongoing.

items.q: What English level is required for the E-TEP exam?
items.a: The required English level for the E-TEP exam should be at least B2 according to the criteria set by ÖSYM. Candidates are expected to have B2 level General English proficiency in CEFR standards or have scored 70 and above in exams like YDS, E-YDS to apply.

items.q: What are the recommendations for success in the E-TEP exam?
items.a: Get to know the format of this four-skill English test well and prepare at least at the B2 level. Practice academic texts for reading, TRT World content for listening, email/blog and report writing for writing, and video interpretation for speaking.

items.q: How effective is the E-TEP exam in measuring academic English?
items.a: This new generation English proficiency test stands out as a highly effective tool in measuring academic English. The exam comprehensively evaluates four basic language skills; it tests all skills required in a university environment such as understanding and analyzing academic texts, writing academic reports by interpreting visual materials, and expressing opinions on video content. It is recognized by YÖK.

items.q: Which resources are recommended for the E-TEP exam?
items.a: Sample questions published by ÖSYM should be the main source. Avcılar English Language Course Language School's special E-TEP preparation sets and online platforms also offer targeted study opportunities. Additionally, TOEFL iBT, IELTS Academic, and PTE Academic preparation books and resources like TRT World and BBC Academic are recommended.

seoContent.title: What is Germany A1 Family Reunification?
seoContent.desc: The Germany A1 Family Reunification exam is compulsory for the 'Germany Family Reunification Visa' required for citizens of the Republic of Turkey living in Turkey to join their relatives, spouses, or children living in Germany. This visa falls under the National (Type D) Visa category. Applications for these long-term visas are made directly to the German Consulate or German Embassy. Documents requested by the authorities of the Federal Republic of Germany must be submitted during the application. The most important detail to consider regarding these documents is that they must be up-to-date and wet-signed. To facilitate the adaptation process of individuals coming to the country under family reunification, it is mandatory to prove that they possess basic German language skills (e.g., 'What is your educational background?', 'Are you working?') expected at the simplest level.

seoContent.title: What Are the Benefits of Learning Japanese?
seoContent.desc: Learning Japanese provides individuals with many advantages. First, your intellectual knowledge about Japanese culture (Origami, Ikebana, Aikido, Kendo, etc.) and pop culture increases. Second, since most Japanese people do not speak English or are hard to understand due to accent differences, knowing Japanese allows you to travel freely and independently in Japan. Third, over 130 million people worldwide speak Japanese; this enables you to get employed in technology giants and easily communicate with Japanese companies. Fourth, since learning Japanese engages the brain differently than other languages, it strengthens memory and enhances problem-solving skills. Finally, Japan scores high globally in innovative education, and learning the language offers you academic educational opportunities.

seoContent.title: The World's Most Complex Writing System: Japanese Alphabets
seoContent.desc: The writing system used in Japan is considered the most complex writing style in the world, posing a major challenge for those coming from Latin-alphabetic languages. Japanese consists of three different writing systems: Hiragana, Katakana, and Kanji. While Kanji consists of Chinese characters, the Kana alphabets (Hiragana and Katakana) are syllabic systems. Hiragana is used in combination with Kanji in almost all written sentences in Japanese. Although memorizing Hiragana and Katakana is relatively easy, Western students coming from non-Kanji cultures definitely need expert support and a systematic educational model in this area.

seoContent.title: Why is Learning Ottoman Turkish Important?
seoContent.desc: Ottoman Turkish is the language of science, art, literature, and statecraft of a global empire that ruled over three continents for six centuries. Millions of manuscripts, edicts, diplomas, and literary texts in our libraries and state archives were written in this language. Knowing Ottoman Turkish is a necessity for anyone who wants to read and understand our history, culture, and literature directly from original sources rather than translations of Western sources. Furthermore, being able to read a deed, an old tombstone, or a historical fountain inscription left by our ancestors gives an individual an invaluable cultural treasure and sense of belonging.

seoContent.title: Is Ottoman Turkish a Difficult Language?
seoContent.desc: There is a common misconception in society that Ottoman Turkish is a difficult and completely foreign language to learn. On the contrary, Ottoman Turkish is actually the Turkish of its period. It simply features a higher density of Arabic and Persian words in its vocabulary and uses Arabic script as its alphabet. The spoken language and core skeleton of the language remain Turkish. With the modern and student-centered approach we offer at Avcılar English Language Course, the alphabet stage, which initially seems unfamiliar, is quickly overcome. When practiced with the right methods, you will see in a short time how enjoyable and relatively easy learning it is.

about.title: Purpose and Target Audience of Latin Education
about.desc:
The origin of Latin traces back to Latium, an Italic language spoken in the Latium region of the Italian Peninsula in the 1st century BC. Shaped by the influence of Etruscans and Greeks, it became the official language of the Roman Empire and was used throughout the Middle Ages to write scientific, academic, and religious texts. Forming the origin of modern European languages today, this language plays a key role in academic studies.

As Avcılar English Language Course, our Latin language course aims to render students competent in reading, writing, listening, understanding, and speaking Latin. A student completing the course with average performance learns the alphabet, spelling, basic grammatical structure, and a substantial vocabulary. Furthermore, they gain extensive knowledge about Roman history, culture, and social structure.

intro.title: History
paragraphs: Avcılar English Language Course was founded on a simple observation: rote-learning, exam-focused methods leave students unable to actually speak in real situations. Our goal was to build a language programme where what happens in the classroom carries over into daily conversations, job interviews, and travel — not just onto paper.

From day one, we recognised that adult and child learners have very different needs, so we built separate curricula, materials, and teaching methods for each age group. We never put a primary-school student and a working adult who needs English for their career in the same classroom with the same textbook.

When building our teaching staff, we looked beyond language knowledge to teaching ability itself, working with experienced instructors and native English speakers to help students learn language that is both accurate and fluent.

Today, alongside our Avcılar headquarters, our branches across different cities reach thousands of students, offering a wide range of programmes from general English to exam preparation, across levels from A1 to C1.
We define quality not by a certificate but by results measured in the classroom — regularly updating our curriculum through level tracking, instructor feedback, and student satisfaction surveys.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions About Academic Exam Preparation

items.q: What is an academic exam preparation course?
items.a: An academic exam preparation course is a comprehensive training programme consisting of exam-specific strategies, question-type analyses and mock exams, designed to help candidates reach their target score in national or international exams such as IELTS, TOEFL, YDS, YÖKDİL, GMAT, GRE and SAT.

items.q: Which exam should I prepare for to study for a postgraduate degree abroad?
items.a: It depends on the country: the US and Canada typically require IELTS or TOEFL plus GRE or GMAT; the UK usually requires IELTS; Germany requires TestDaF or a Goethe certificate. Our education consultants will point you in the right direction.

items.q: What is the difference between YDS and YÖKDİL?
items.a: YDS (Foreign Language Proficiency Test) is administered by ÖSYM, while YÖKDİL is run under YÖK coordination. YDS covers a broader scope for public service appointments and academics, whereas YÖKDİL is mainly used for postgraduate programme applications.

items.q: How do I determine my level before starting an exam prep course?
items.a: Avcılar English Language Course offers a free placement test to determine your current English level. Based on the results, you will be directed to the most suitable programme for your target exam.

items.q: What is the difference between GMAT and GRE?
items.a: GMAT is mainly accepted by MBA and business postgraduate programmes, while GRE is valid across a wide range of postgraduate fields including engineering, social sciences and natural sciences. Many MBA programmes now accept both.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions About Other Language Courses

items.q: How long does a German course take?
items.a: The duration of a German course depends on your level and programme intensity. On average, 6-8 months for A1-A2 basic level and 8-12 months for B1-B2 intermediate level. Intensive programmes can shorten these durations.

items.q: Is there a prerequisite for learning Japanese?
items.a: No, our Japanese courses are designed with programmes starting completely from scratch. We progress step by step starting from the Hiragana and Katakana alphabets.

items.q: Do language courses provide certificates?
items.a: Students who complete our course receive an Avcılar English Language Course participation certificate. In addition, preparation for international exams such as Goethe (German), DELF/DALF (French) and DELE (Spanish) is also provided.

items.q: Which level language course should I take?
items.a: Your existing language knowledge is measured through our free placement test and you are placed at the correct level within the CEFR (A1-C2) framework.

items.q: How quickly can I speak in difficult languages like Russian and Arabic?
items.a: Even though these languages are structurally different from Turkish, it is possible to reach daily communication level within 6-8 months with regular study. Our instructors use the method that will provide the fastest progress.
